newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialists want Communists in government.
newsitem.headline: French Socialists want Communists in government.

text.p: France's victorious Socialist party said on Monday it wanted all left-wing parties, including the Communists, to join a government led by prime minister- designate Lionel Jospin.

Socialist spokesman Francois Hollande made the comment to reporters after Jospin and Socialist leaders discussed the formation of a broad left administration following Sunday's parliamentary election triumph.
"We are in favour of all the movements that enabled the victory of the left joining together in government...That naturally applies to the Communists," Hollande said.
The Communists' policymaking national council agreed in principle on Monday to enter a Socialist-led government but said it had written to Jospin seeking undertakings on policy.
The Communists won 38 seats in the 577-seat National Assembly and will hold the balance of power.

The national leadership of the ecologist Greens, who won eight seats to enter parliament for the first time, also voted to join a government and said they hoped to win both an enlarged environment ministry and a portfolio dealing with shorter working hours and women's rights.
